title: check stays read-only with SeamSpec, and with --ci runs no SeamSpec command
assertion: In a repository set up by `swerepo init` with SeamSpec set up and chosen (a ledger where one hygiene rule is adopted, one locked, one proposed and one not yet proposed) and a `docs/EARNED_SPEC.md`, with a fake `seamspec` first on PATH that logs every call: `swerepo check --ci` on GitHub Actions makes no call to `seamspec` at all. `swerepo check` on a person's machine (every component) calls `seamspec` with exactly `--version`, `doctor --json` and `spec --check docs/EARNED_SPEC.md`, the last at least once, and nothing else, and reports each of the four hygiene rules with its status. Both leave every file and folder unchanged (names, sizes, modification times and contents, folders' modification times included, `.git` included).

origin.text: ADR-20261124-cd64 point 9: check for the seamspec component runs only SeamSpec's read-only commands (--version, doctor --json, spec --check, checked to write nothing with SeamSpec 0.1.2), and with --ci runs none; inv_294c48c9's promise that check never writes, extended to this component. Tightened twice after SeamSpec's reviewer: spec --check exercised, exact arguments, the fake on PATH, folders' modification times, and all four hygiene statuses.
